limitations: No new real forest-bird held-out events were collected
CUB has no human head-box test truth
Public/pretraining overlap unknown; no claim of camera transfer
Coarse public head-box geometry is weak supervision
Missing parts are unknown; no complete fallback/subject-identity evaluation
Macro F1 is a development selection proxy; full wrong-target-rate criterion remains unavailable
Sparse-positive teacher admission was amended after validation inspection
Exact paired-run initialization requires saved snapshots; original creation seed unknown

pipeline_benchmark.scope: warm filesystem cache; PNG decode, preprocessing, CPU/GPU transfers, model, C consumer/custom decode; no BA2 validation interpreter
pipeline_benchmark.native_implementation: physical integer/half arithmetic replay through CUDA tensor operations; not camera implementation
pipeline_benchmark.student_implementation: PyTorch CUDA conv with FP16 autocast; unfused modified pose-derived n
pipeline_benchmark.comparison_limit: same computer and image inputs, different operator implementations; do not convert speed ratio to hardware cost ratio or camera FPS
